title: Pod Analyzer Manual Action
description: Determine whether the workload's pods scheduled and started correctly, in two stages (Kueue admission / kube-scheduler, then kubelet sandbox, image pull and volume mount). Both queries match failure events only, so an empty result is reported as INCONCLUSIVE unless an explicit window was supplied -- it is not evidence the pods were healthy.

start.description: RFC3339 start of the run window. Required to reach a historical incident: without it gcloud applies a 1-day default freshness and the analyzer reports INCONCLUSIVE_NO_EVENTS_FOUND rather than a verdict.

end.description: RFC3339 end of the run window.

output_file.description: Destination for the JSON report. Must live under scratch/.
